description: This file defines a class '_PROXY_CacheControlCheck' that extends 'CustomLogger' to implement a hook for pre-call cache control validation in a FastAPI-based proxy. It verifies allowed cache control directives based on user API key permissions and raises HTTP exceptions for unauthorized cache control modifications.

classes.name: _PROXY_CacheControlCheck
classes.description: A class that extends 'CustomLogger' to perform cache control validation before processing API calls.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: str, )
methods.description: Asynchronous method invoked before an API call to verify cache control permissions based on user API key. It inspects 'cache' data, compares against allowed controls, and raises HTTP exceptions if unauthorized controls are specified.
